## Made to be sat in

The Aurora frame is cut from a single oiled oak billet, steam-bent rather than jointed, so the arm and the rear leg are one continuous piece. It takes four days to set.

## Care

Wipe the frame with a barely-damp cloth. Re-oil once a year. The bouclé is removable and dry-clean only.
